policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the qere, which is what MACULA Hebrew projects; the alternative is the ketiv written in the Leningrad Codex.

decisions.evidence: ASV 'That ye may know there is a judgment' renders relative ש + דין 'judgment' either way; the qere/ketiv difference is a vowel-letter spelling of the same word and no English wording or italicized supply distinguishes it. The only note ('Or, wrathful are') is alternative_rendering on 'wrath bringeth' and does not touch this unit. Retain the qere base fallback.
